description: resolve_protocol_call keeps two impl-discovery mechanisms: the new scope-tier provider index (user modules) and runtime_impl_target_modules (the 'impl lives in the receiver type's own module' name convention, for lazily-submitted runtime modules). Once runtime modules' defimpls are index/scope-discovered on ensure, the convention can retire and the provider index becomes the single source of truth. Needs care around lazy runtime submission ordering.

comments.text: Superseded by epic fz-hwn.19.2.4.16 (Elixir-aligned protocol dispatch). The collapse is realized by T2 (dispatch demands Protocol.Target directly) + T5 (delete runtime_impl_target_modules). Closing as superseded.

title: Collapse runtime_impl_target_modules into the scope-tier provider index
